hypothesis: The current 13 source-grounded eight-step LoRA recipe suffices to demonstrate genuinely differentiated neural personalities with retained coding competence.
falsifier: No corrected candidate/sham/corrupt model receipts or no independent reserved behavioral-and-coding inference, or a demonstrated coding regression.

definitions.source_ready: Traceable case materials, deterministic schedule, tests, and experimental trainer are present in source.
definitions.demonstrate: Observed post-training neutral-vs-trait behavioral gains and coding retention against donor, prompt-only, historical, sham, and corrupted-label controls on reserved cases.
definitions.independence: Review identity is not provider, host, or model independence; attributable external invocation receipts would be needed for that stronger claim.

evidence.claim: The composed BT2 source suite passed 122 tests and validated 13 dossiers/130 cases at the exact PR #99 head.
evidence.method: Local exact-commit tests and GitHub CI run 40863934639 were read back.
evidence.reliability: Source and test evidence, not model inference.

evidence.claim: Fresh WorkBridge and Executor probes timed out; candidate/sham/corrupt training did not run.
evidence.source: BT2 host gate 2026-10-29 report (separate retained evidence)
evidence.method: Bounded authenticated connector probes, no fresh host resource readback.
evidence.reliability: Observed transport timeout and explicit no-go.
evidence.uncertainty: Actual host memory capacity and recovery state unknown.

reviews.finding: The source recipe is input/mechanism evidence; neural differentiation and coding retention are unobserved consequents.
reviews.objection: The original hypothesis improperly promotes source readiness into verified model behavior.

reviews.finding: Unqualified host access prevented the matched training arms and independent reserved inference; thirteen release reviews now would lack measurement.
reviews.objection: A cheap source check is not a substitute for a bounded canary and operational receipts.

reviews.finding: Unproven persona labels risk false trust in independent expertise, especially with correlated models and prompt-only behavior.
reviews.objection: No neutral-versus-trait, coding-retention, source-pinned control comparison exists for all thirteen corrected weights.

challenges.target: Proposer claim that source readiness demonstrates trained effects
challenges.question: Where are corrected adapter SHA receipts and blind neutral-versus-trait and coding results for each identity? Will you concede the narrower claim if absent?
challenges.defense: Proposer /root explicitly concedes no corrected neural artifact/evaluation evidence; only source-ready experimental design survives and efficacy remains unknown.

challenges.target: Matched control and host feasibility claims
challenges.question: Where are exact candidate, zero-update sham, and corrupted-label receipts and reserved inference versus donor, prompt-only and older coding models?
challenges.defense: Proposer /root explicitly concedes the arms and independent inference were not run; first restore authenticated host access and execute one bounded canary.

challenges.question: What independently scored evidence separates learned role behavior from prompt conformity and rules out coding regression?
challenges.defense: Proposer /root concedes no such scored evidence exists; role labels must not imply tested competence or independent model execution.

rationale: REFINE: the broad neural-efficacy claim fails observed-evidence requirements. Source-ready training/evaluation design survives; behavioral differentiation and coding retention remain UNKNOWN.
refined_claim: BT2 contains thirteen source-grounded personality training dossiers and a bounded experimental training/evaluation recipe, but no corrected neural behavior has yet been qualified.
review_custody_limitations: These were three distinct native ChatGPT child-agent reviews in one provider/runtime context, not three local GGUF executions or cryptographically authenticated independent model/host attestations. The proposer wrote a concession; the transcript is not an append-only signed ledger.
